rules: application policy resolves only typed app events into typed business actions
unknown event families are rejected, never mapped to fallback actions
business actions are a closed whitelist; control, sequence, retry, ack and metadata never enter them
no renderer or focus manager calls the Host directly
cancel maps only to the current selected Session
submit maps to the current selected Session or fails closed
resume/quit/approval/question/selector actions carry only typed payloads
app-shell composes modules but owns no presentation parsing or Session event interpretation
